defects: Selecting Eraser only changes UI state. handlePointerDown always passes state.color to paintPixel regardless of selected tool, explicitly to satisfy compatibility assumptions, so an erase stroke paints an opaque pixel.

drawLine calls paintPixel without its required fillColor argument. In the final implementation a missing fillColor means erase, so a brush drag clears its entire path instead of painting a continuous stroke.

History captures pre-stroke buffers but undo decrements past the immediately previous valid state. Two separate strokes followed by one Undo remove both instead of preserving the first. Undo Clear similarly loses the newest stroke; Redo cannot recover the final unsaved state.

The agent replaced a larger painter with a simpler implementation during its last repair, but retained or introduced these core interaction defects. Repeated tester/repair stage limits did not produce a verified working painter.

The final reviewer marks pass with no blocking findings while explicitly admitting that Eraser is tested only by its active CSS state, palette use is not checked against pixels and Undo/Redo is checked only through history text.
